notes.title: Patch 2.0.101
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed the error that sometimes blocked the players to play multiplayer game.

[b]New Feature:[/b]
Toon Troops is now prepared to play multiplayer cross platform with the Meta Quest Version, now you can play against the Meta Quest version that will be released soon!

notes.title: Version 2.0 is live!
notes.notes: We promise we deliver! New maps and Story mode. Now you can open new scenarios to play with your friends!

Minor bug fixes on online game fixed.
New features coming soon as well as our Demo!

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Now players can play against other players in other regions. For example if you have friends outside your region ex. EU you can choose that region in the Lobby.

We also fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Game Tutorial Feature
notes.notes:
The game tutorial is finally here!
Now players can learn the game without losing points on a real game. Also if you want to practice your skills don't forget to play [b]Solo Mode[/b] before joining a Multiplayer match!
